purpose: Controlled test: is the scale-test NT-500M win over Markov baseline-FRAGILE or WINDOW-dependent? Hold the scale window fixed, vary ONLY the Markov training-set size.
window: canFam4 chr1 NC_051804.1:20,000,000-20,001,200 (the scale-test eval window)
interpretation: A 200kb Markov barely beats a 4kb one on this window (-0.018 nats); NT-500M still wins by +0.27 here. So the scale-test window was FAVORABLE (easy); the F2 windows are harder. The scale/F2 disagreement is window-sampling, not baseline strength. F2 finding #1 (anti-structured: NT worse in coding) is unaffected and stands.
reproduces_scale_test: Markov-4kb best-k=2 NLL 1.3561 matches wiki/dog_nt_scale_2026-07-31.json exactly -> setup validated
method: local, dna_decode.interp.markov_baseline.MarkovModel (no NT re-run needed; NT NLL already established)
